name: Auto Borrowing 2 Code
definition: Specifies the condition under which automatic borrowing is allowed.

LAMI.name: Last Resort
LAMI.definition: Only last resort borrowing should be considered to make settlement occur.

NBOR.name: No Automatic
NBOR.definition: No automatic borrowing should take place.

RTRN.name: Return
RTRN.definition: Return of stocks should take place.
